`./compile.sh` reports **`compiled OK`**.

## What was produced

`tests/org/apache/commons/csv/CSVFormatAgentTest.java` — a self-contained JUnit 3.8 test (`extends junit.framework.TestCase`, matching `lib/junit-3.8.1.jar`; no external helpers, no JUnit 4 imports, `-source 8`-clean). A private `assertCharEquals` helper sidesteps any primitive-`assertEquals` overload questions, and a nested `SampleHeader` enum is the only fixture.

### Coverage (all expectations grounded in `api/` javadoc)

| Area | Tests |
|---|---|
| `newFormat(char)` | delimiter set; every other field null/false per contract; rejects `\n` / `\r` with `IllegalArgumentException` |
| Immutability | `with*` calls don't mutate the receiver; `withDelimiter` returns a new instance and preserves unrelated settings |
| `withCommentMarker` / `withEscape` / `withQuote` | `char` + `Character` overloads set value and `isXxxSet()`; `(Character) null` clears; line-break chars rejected |
| `withNullString` | round-trip + `isNullStringSet()`; `null` clears |
| `withRecordSeparator` | accepts CR / LF / CRLF (char and String); rejects other strings |
| Boolean withers | no-arg variants set `true`; explicit `true`/`false` round-trip for all 7 flags |
| Headers | `String...` round-trip; `getHeader()` / `getHeaderComments()` return defensive copies; no-arg → empty array; `null` disables; enum-class header; `withFirstRecordAsHeader` == header + skip |
| `withQuoteMode` | round-trip; unset after `newFormat` |
| `equals` / `hashCode` / `toString` | reflexive, value-based, hashCode agreement, distinguishes delimiter change and the documented DEFAULT-vs-RFC4180 `ignoreEmptyLines` difference, rejects null/foreign types, toString non-empty and format-specific |
| `valueOf` / `Predefined` | maps names to formats; unknown name throws; case-sensitive; all 7 `Predefined.getFormat()` values; `values().length == 7` |
| Predefined settings | DEFAULT, RFC4180, EXCEL, MYSQL, TDF, INFORMIX_UNLOAD, INFORMIX_UNLOAD_CSV — each asserted against its documented "Settings are" block |
| `format(Object...)` | delimiter join, single/zero values, custom delimiter, quoting of embedded delimiter, null → nullString |
| `print` / `printRecord` / `println` | exact output written to a `StringBuilder` (record + separator, custom delimiter/separator, quoting, nullString, separator-only, new-record vs continuation); `print(Appendable/File/Path)` return non-null printers and the File is created |
| `parse(Reader)` | returns a non-null parser |
